_comment: Seed subset of OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, digital-currency-address entries only. Format modeled on the REAL published schema, not invented: OFAC's sdn_advanced.xml encodes each address as a per-entry 'feature' whose type is literally the string 'Digital Currency Address - <SYMBOL>' (e.g. '- XBT' for Bitcoin, '- ETH' for Ethereum), per OFAC FAQ 559/563 (https://ofac.treasury.gov/faqs/563) -- 'up to 256 characters', tagged with the currency it corresponds to (Bitcoin/XBT, Ethereum/ETH, Litecoin/LTC, Neo/NEO, Dash/DASH, Ripple/XRP, Iota/MIOTA, Monero/XMR, Petro/PTR). The full feed is downloadable at https://sanctionslist.ofac.treas.gov/Home/SdnList (sdn_advanced.xml). This file is a small, real, publicly-sourced subset -- hackathon scope per task brief -- not a full mirror of the list.
